decision.title: A status for failed input and output

body.p: (was P1, from ; accepted by the orchestrator, added in packet ). SXML_STATUS_INPUT_OUTPUT_FAILED in include/sxml/status.h means the platform refused to read or write bytes for a host interface (a closed pipe, a full disk, a missing file) while the sxml object and its arguments were fine. Host callbacks that read or write bytes return it: the CLI's output streams and platform layer now, the serializer's output and the document resolver of later. It carries no error record; a host that maps it to a specification error (for example fn:doc and FODC0002) does so itself. Rejected: reusing SXML_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, which blames the caller for a platform failure.
